children: Zicix’s revenue rose from zero as consulting services generated revenue, while its net loss narrowed year over year. Lower interest and other expenses, including no fair-value loss on convertible debt, partly offset higher general and administrative expenses.
¹ Reported as “Revenues, net”. ² Reported as “NET LOSS”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Consulting service income was $39,837; the company reported no product sales in the quarter.
: One customer accounted for 100% of quarterly revenue.
: Operations remained temporarily ceased because supply-chain and transit disruptions tied to the U.S.-Iraq conflict prevented scheduled shipments.
: Bank accounts were suspended as of September 30, leaving no cash balances; certain convertible debts totaling approximately $701,000 were in default.
